source_differences: Capacity: lift-world/remontees 900 p/h vs 2006 list 1020 p/h.
Section A-B length: lift-world 2689 m vs 2006 list 2680 m, station C 1649 m (lift-world, 2006 list) vs 1639 m (remontees), D 2200 m vs 2204 m vs hiking-trail 2202 m.

Correction note relies on Wikipedia 'closed 2013, reopen 2016/17'. Newer sources: lift-world and remontees mark it closed 2023, Slovenia Times reports ZAG found not all sections fit to operate and Poma advised no operation beyond 2022. The record's status text should not imply current operation.
Section lengths A-B 2689, B-C 1870, C-D 1310 m add up to 5869 m (Uradni list 2006: 2680 + 1870 + 1310 = 5860 m), which does not match the 5110 m total.
Capacity 900 p/h (lift-world) vs 1020 p/h (Uradni list 2006). Stations C and D at 1639 and 2204 m (remontees-mecaniques) vs 1649 and 2200 m (Uradni list 2006).
